decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from BurntSushi/jiff PR #617, merged 2026-07-28, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. jiff_core::tz::Offset::checked_sub called the checked ADD ranged-integer routine, so it added the subtrahend (UTC.checked_sub(1) yielded +1s) and its range check bounded the wrong direction; the fix computes the subtraction in i64 and range-checks the true result (localized, one source file; the public jiff crate's own Offset arithmetic does not route through this routine, which is why the hidden tests target jiff-core's public API directly). Kept as a small localized anchor. Workspace sliced at the PR base commit (2584cff7) with cargo-prune to the closure of the jiff crate; the dependent integration crates (jiff-diesel/icu/sqlx/wasm) are dropped from the workspace to keep the vendor tree sane; third-party deps vendored with a regenerated lockfile (the upstream .gitignore Cargo.lock rule is stripped so offline builds reproduce); rust-2024 image. MIT/Unlicense preserved. jiff-core auto-discovers integration tests, so the hidden tests need no manifest overlay: vb_offset_sub.rs (fail_to_pass, 3 tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch) covers subtracting positive and negative seconds and the range error at both bounds; vb_offset_reg.rs (pass_to_pass) guards checked_add, accessors/until, and the i32::MIN subtrahend which errors at base and after alike. Assertions compare Offset values via constant_seconds and error presence, never message text.
